title: skipsAnalytics
responsibility: Recognizes help, version, info, and empty-argument invocations that should not write analytics events.

inputs.name: skipsAnalytics.args
inputs.description: CLI argument vector, excluding the executable and script names, that the function reads without modifying. Only args[0] and the entries before the first `--` are checked, by exact case-sensitive string match, and an empty array returns true.

outputs.name: skipsAnalytics
outputs.description: Whether analytics should be skipped for this invocation: true when there are no arguments, when `--help` or `-h` appears before the first `--` (or anywhere, if there is no `--`), or when args[0] is `help`, `info`, `--version`, or `-V`. It is false otherwise, and it depends only on the arguments because the function reads no state.
